title.zh: 有限支持下无法及时恢复的正区间
title.en: Positive seed intervals that finite support cannot rescue in time

claim.zh: 对每条带可容许扰动的变化之律，以及被其步耗竭的每个层族（守卫给出第0级；守卫之内的构型经一个可容许步到第k级，则原在第k+1级），低于第n级的起点在每段可容许历史上n步内离开守卫；处于第n级并不足够。量在每个可容许步上的增长受单调映射约束时，它停在该映射的轨道之下；若量的轨道在第k+1步不超过阈值时，每个可容许步使层级降一，则轨道在第n步不超过阈值、且不在第n级的起点，在每段可容许历史上n步内离开守卫。市场是实例（旧定理由此律证明）：份额每步至多乘3/2，份额轨道不超过1/6时每步使存量在底线5之上少一单位。所以对每个有理C₀≥5及整数N>C₀−5，正维护区间0<x₀≤(2/3)^N/6在任意时变β／责任误差及非负支持冲击下均至迟在N失效。同一正初态在β=0、最佳初始责任和无误差／耗用下，运行投影有限恢复而完整守卫历史终止。
claim.en: For every law of change with admissible disturbances and every family of levels its steps drain (within the guard is level 0, and a configuration within the guard that one admissible step takes to level k was at level k+1), a start below level n leaves the guard within n steps on every admissible history; being at level n does not suffice. A quantity whose growth on each admissible step is bounded by a monotone map stays below the map's orbit; where each admissible step lowers the level by one while the quantity's orbit k+1 steps on is at or below a threshold, every start whose orbit at step n is at or below the threshold and which is not at level n leaves the guard within n steps on every admissible history. The market is an instance, the old theorem being proved from the law, the share growing at most by 3/2 a step and each step taking one unit of the stock above the floor 5 while the share's orbit stays at or below 1/6: for every rational C0>=5 and integer N>C0-5, all positive seeds 0<x0<=(2/3)^N/6 fail by N under every time-varying beta/quality-error sequence and nonnegative support shock. The same positive state with beta=0, best initial quality and no error/extra consumption has projected finite recovery but full guarded termination.

hypotheses.zh: 原有理State、shareStep与supportStep、必要支持底线5保留；x₀、q₀在[0,1]，原完整守卫逐步执行。
hypotheses.en: The original rational State, shareStep, supportStep and essential-stock floor five remain; initial x and q are in [0,1], with the original guard at each step.

hypotheses.zh: β及责任误差允许任意逐期变化，clip限制q；支持冲击非负，没有直接支持注入、进入、扩展速度改变或组织切换。
hypotheses.en: Beta and quality error may vary arbitrarily each step, with q clipped; stock shocks are nonnegative, with no direct stock injection, entry, change of expansion rate or organizational switch.

correspondence.zh: 维护与支持是同一步活动的相关坐标；时变控制覆盖已实现反馈所产生的序列，但不解释反馈形成。底线及速率须有现实根据，none仅表示所表示的市场组织停止。
correspondence.en: Renewal and stock are related coordinates updated in the same activity. Time-varying control includes sequences produced by realized feedback but does not explain feedback formation. Floors and rates require actual correspondence; none ends the represented market organization only.

detail.zh: 复用原扩展上界及正余量有限到达，新增全控制有限支持阻碍。
detail.en: Reuses the old growth upper bound and positive-seed finite arrival to prove a new all-control finite-support obstruction.

input.en: next_share_upper and projected_recovery_and_actual_failure consume them; zero_schedule_is_original_pulse reconnects the original full guard.

conditions.zh: 同一增长与支持关系，投影到达不视为完整历史执行。
conditions.en: Same growth and support relations; projected arrival is not taken as full execution.

detail.zh: 以相同有限支持、高维护初态保留可继续的实质对照。
detail.en: Retains a continuing high-renewal comparison with the same finite stock.

output.en: example_certificate and safe_history_never_fails supply inherited all-time protection.

input.en: same_stock_can_support_high_seed constructs Safe and invokes that protection.

conditions.en: x=q=1, w=0, budget one, C0>=5, no shocks, original beta=1/2.

detail.zh: 其无误差普遍投影到达阈值保留；新结果限定同一转变的实际支持。
detail.en: Its zero-error universal projected-arrival threshold remains; the new result constrains actual support for that transition.

detail.zh: 复用既有条件基础中的支持限制，推进具体生成—维持—终止连接，不宣告零实质公理。
detail.en: Reuses established conditional support limits to advance a concrete formation-maintenance-ending connection without claiming zero substantive axioms.

detail.zh: 实际形成的历史接续，明确原固定律所省略关系；不反驳或数值验证此定理。
detail.en: Historical formed continuation identifies relationships omitted by the fixed-law model; it neither refutes nor numerically validates this theorem.

detail.zh: projected_recovery_and_actual_failure保留相同正初态投影恢复而实际终止；same_stock_can_support_high_seed反驳有限支持必然失败。
detail.en: projected_recovery_and_actual_failure retains projected recovery and actual termination for the same seed; same_stock_can_support_high_seed refutes inevitable failure from finite stock alone.

detail.zh: Collapse.level_not_lasting：被耗竭的族在第1级含true，而true持续不了一步，所以处于第n级不足以持续。
detail.en: Collapse.level_not_lasting: a drained family holds true at level 1, yet true does not last one step, so being at level n does not suffice.

limitations.zh: δ_N是保守失败区间而非精确可恢复域；不排除实际供给、依存转化、进入或更快形成改变边界。未证分岔、R-tipping分类、现实死亡或无附加实质公理奠基。
limitations.en: The delta_N interval is a conservative obstruction, not an exact viability boundary. Actual provision, dependence change, entry or faster formation may alter it. No bifurcation, R-tipping classification, physical death or zero-added-substantive-axiom foundation is proved.

Standard logical axiom dependencies are retained; author counterreview, no independent agent or new market observations. General laws: checker receipts bound.

Next obtain real timing, support and uninterrupted conditions at each stage of a specific reorganization before proving which quantitative boundary it crosses.

history.zh: 2026-10-16，P114 散立的模块在共同基底上陈述（研究 §138；Ren 2026-10-15：“so for our theories, they are proved in a dag order and can be all connected right?”）：主律在共同基底上陈述，不加前提：受扰过程的运行就是其诸步的可容许历史（run_history、run_admissible；反之 historyRun）。于是在被耗竭的家族第 n 级之下的起点，在受扰过程的每个运行上于 n 步之内离开护栏（Drains.leaves_run）；有界增长下的耗竭律对受扰过程的每个运行成立（exhausts_run）。Becoming.Courses 由核心运行编译与审计（回执 20261015T172257.067968Z），公理报告为空。论断、假设、Ren 的话、依赖与既有证明不变；只加引用、绑定、别名与本条。
history.en: 16 October 2026, P114, the apart modules read on the shared base (study section 138; Ren, 15 October: “so for our theories, they are proved in a dag order and can be all connected right?”): the main law stated on the shared base, no premise added: a run of the disturbed process is the admissible history of its moves (run_history, run_admissible; conversely historyRun). So a start below level n of a drained family leaves the guard within n steps on every run of the disturbed process (Drains.leaves_run), and exhaustion by bounded growth holds on every run (exhausts_run). Becoming.Courses is compiled and audited by the core run (receipt 20261015T172257.067968Z), with empty axiom reports. Claims, hypotheses, Ren's words, dependencies and the earlier proofs are unchanged; only references, bindings, aliases and this entry are added.
